runs.t: Clark Pacific is expanding to the Pacific Northwest — new plant opening Q3 2026.
Structural precast systems and exterior wall panels for mission-critical facilities — with early design-assist and in-house manufacturing for accelerated schedules and project predictability.
Proven, scalable, and repeatable precast solutions for data centers and advanced manufacturing facilities — offering expedited schedules and robust structural resilience.
A practical solution for commercial, industrial, and data center projects, whether used as cladding or as a load-bearing system. Customizable to project-specific thermal requirements.
A high-density prestressed deck system engineered to carry AI-era white-space loads and heavy rooftop mechanical platforms without compromise on schedule or cost.
A factory-built mechanical platform system that further accelerates the construction schedule and streamlines chiller installation for hyperscale data center facilities.

runs.t: Precast systems adapt to future expansion — floor loads, column spacing, and openings can be engineered for tomorrow's demands.
Parallel offsite fabrication compresses the critical path by two to four months on a typical 100-megawatt data center build.
Reduced rework, fewer field trades, and predictable logistics translate directly to tens of millions in savings per project.
Factory-controlled production and just-in-time delivery from our regional plants ensure panels arrive on your schedule, every time.
CARBONSHIELD® mix designs reduce embodied carbon by 40% vs. traditional concrete — with EPDs available for every project.
Precast concrete is inherently fire-resistant and seismically capable — built to protect your investment for decades.
Sq ft of structural and enclosure systems
Our offsite manufacturing approach reduces overall project risk through improved cost and schedule certainty and greater supply chain control — without compromising a project's overall design.
Factory-fabricated structural components arrive on-site ready to erect, running parallel to foundation and MEP work to compress the critical path by two to four months on a typical 100MW facility.
Our engineers engage at schematic design to optimize the structural system for your site, program, and schedule — before a single component is cast.
Every component is manufactured in our California plants under rigorous quality control — with factory precision that field-built systems cannot match.
Just-in-time delivery from our regional plants and a dedicated erection crew ensure panels arrive and go up on your schedule, every time.
